_about: Where to report a false positive, per antivirus vendor. Kept by hand: read by
publish/virustotal-fp.py, which groups VirusTotal's flagging engines under these vendors
by the engine names in 'engines' (the keys of a VirusTotal analysis's results). An engine
listed nowhere becomes a vendor of its own with no contact. Only addresses known to be
right are filled in; an empty 'url' and 'email' means look it up (VirusTotal's list
below, or the vendor's site) and fill it in here once it has worked. Correct an entry
whenever a submission bounces or a form moves.
